subject.title: fix(whatsapp): suppress typing for unmentioned group runs regardless of delivery mode

question: Should WhatsApp land this narrow all-unmentioned `suppressTyping` mitigation, or wait for the broader visible-delivery typing boundary before changing automatic group typing semantics?
rationale: Both paths can address false WhatsApp typing indicators, but tests cannot decide the user-visible tradeoff where proactive visible unmentioned replies lose their typing flash.

options.title: Rebase The Narrow Mitigation
options.body: Refresh this branch onto current main and adapt the predicate to `conversationKind` plus current group mention metadata while preserving the command carve-out.

options.title: Prefer Visible Delivery
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90477 as the canonical path only after its conflicts and Plugin SDK compatibility risks are resolved.

options.title: Keep Current Behavior
options.body: Leave automatic unmentioned group turns with their current typing behavior until a live repro or product priority raises the urgency.

recommendation.title: Rebase The Narrow Mitigation
recommendation.body: Refresh this branch onto current main and adapt the predicate to `conversationKind` plus current group mention metadata while preserving the command carve-out.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr owns the overlapping broader visible-delivery PR and has recent merged history in the WhatsApp inbound dispatch area.
